title: Song - The First Noel (simplified)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: The First Noel in D major and 3/4, over one held block chord a bar in the left (D, G, A).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1243-first-noel: The First Noel (hymntune), SATB, D major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1243)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1243), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (D, G, A), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 80 instead of 96 quarter notes a minute.
